Carrier-grade bulk SMS platform delivering to Safaricom, Airtel and Telkom through a queue-driven pipeline of message-driven workers. Customers integrate via a signed push API with API keys and IP whitelisting, test in a developer sandbox, top up via M-Pesa and run Excel uploads, campaigns and scheduled sends. Also ran the migration to Keycloak 26 with custom Java tooling to notify and re-role users.
